//: License texts scripts/gen-third-party-licenses.mjs cannot read from node_modules.
packages: bundled npm packages whose published tarball ships no license file.
The text comes from the package's repository at the pinned version (`source`).
An entry is keyed by exact name and version: when the package moves, the
generator fails until the text is re-fetched for the new version, and it fails
for an entry the package no longer needs (it started shipping its own file).
embedded: code compiled INTO a bundled package, which no package manager
reports. Each is recorded against the host version it was verified for; when
pnpm-lock.yaml stops resolving that host version, the generator fails until
someone re-checks what the host now embeds.
